message.Title: Generally Available: Azure Arc-enabled SQL Server in Germany West Central

Body.Content:
Azure Arc-enabled SQL Server is now available in Germany West Central, enabling you to connect SQL Server instances to Azure Arc and take advantage of Azure-based inventory, governance, security, assessment, and license management capabilities. 

Learn more.
